biotools.summary: Nanopore Current Events Magnifier (nanoCEM) is a Python command-line tool designed to facilitate the identification of DNA/RNA modification sites through enhanced visualization and statistical analysis of nanopore sequencing data. It is compatible with multiple preprocessing methods and offers improved visualization of current events.
